eta_membrane.description: Membrane PRO efficiency (fraction of osmotic pressure extracted)

eta_turbine.description: Hydro-turbine efficiency on pressurized permeate side

nu_NaCl.description: van't Hoff factor for NaCl (dissociates into 2 ions)

Q_feed_m3_per_s.description: Total feed volumetric flow (seawater + freshwater, equal split)

recovery_ratio.description: Fraction of freshwater feed permeated through membrane

source: Yip & Elimelech (2012) Environ. Sci. Technol. 46:5230; Straub et al. (2016) Nature Energy 1:16090; REDstack BV data.
